name: TheHive - Case Management Platform
description: TheHive is the SOC's case management system. Used to triage alerts, create/manage incident cases, assign tasks, enrich IOCs via Cortex, and document investigation findings.
notes:
HTB lab credentials: htb-analyst / P3n#31337@LOG

Key TheHive concepts:
• Alert — inbound detection from SIEM/sensor, not yet a case. Triage first.
• Case — confirmed incident being actively investigated. Has tasks, IOCs, observables, timeline.
• Observable — any IOC attached to a case (IP, hash, domain, filename). Cortex can auto-enrich.
• Task — discrete action assigned to an analyst (e.g. 'collect forensic image from DEV-021').

Alert lifecycle: Alert → Triage → Create Case → Assign Tasks → Investigate → Close.

Cortex integration: right-click any observable → Analyze → select analyser (VirusTotal, AbuseIPDB, etc.).

Case severity: P1=Critical, P2=High, P3=Medium, P4=Low — set at case creation, adjust as scope expands.
